title: FLASK: FINE-GRAINED LANGUAGE MODEL EVALUATION BASED ON ALIGNMENT SKILL SETS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as part of the 'Harmlessness' skill within the FLASK protocol, where human or LLM evaluators score model responses on a 1 to 5 scale based on whether the model refrains from biased content and controversial statements.

Quantitatively measured by prompting the target model to generate more verbose responses while retaining the original content, and calculating the consistency ratio at which the LLM evaluator assigns the same score despite stylistic changes.
